title: Naboth’s Vineyard

questions.question: What did Ahab want from Naboth?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:2 (ESV): "And Ahab said to Naboth, 'Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a vegetable garden...'"

questions.question: Why did Naboth refuse?
options: The Lord forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers
He wanted to keep it for his son
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:3 (ESV): "But Naboth said to Ahab, 'The LORD forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers.'"

questions.question: Who plotted to get the vineyard for Ahab?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:7 (ESV): "And Jezebel his wife said to him... 'Arise and eat bread... I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.'"

questions.question: How was Naboth killed?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:13 (ESV): "...Then they took him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones."

questions.question: Who did God send to confront Ahab?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:17 (ESV): "Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying, 'Arise, go down to meet Ahab...'"

questions.question: What was the specific charge against Naboth?
options: He has cursed God and the King
questions.correctAnswer: He has cursed God and the King
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:10 (ESV): "...and testify against him, saying, 'You have cursed God and the king.' Then take him out and stone him..."

questions.question: What judgment was pronounced against Jezebel?
options: The dogs shall eat Jezebel within the walls of Jezreel
She will fall from a window
questions.correctAnswer: The dogs shall eat Jezebel within the walls of Jezreel
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:23 (ESV): "And of Jezebel the LORD also said, 'The dogs shall eat Jezebel within the walls of Jezreel.'"

questions.question: How did Ahab react to Elijah's words?
options: He tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and fasted
questions.correctAnswer: He tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and fasted
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:27 (ESV): "And when Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes and put sackcloth on his flesh and fasted..."

questions.question: What effect did Ahab's repentance have?
options: God would not bring the disaster in his days, but in his son's days
questions.correctAnswer: God would not bring the disaster in his days, but in his son's days
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:29 (ESV): "...I will not bring the disaster in his days; but in his son's days I will bring the disaster upon his house."

questions.question: Who stirred up Ahab to do evil?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:25 (ESV): "(There was none who sold himself to do what was evil in the sight of the LORD like Ahab, whom Jezebel his wife incited.)"

questions.question: Where was Naboth from?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:1 (ESV): "Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard in Jezreel..."

questions.question: How many worthless men were seated opposite Naboth?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:10 (ESV): "And set two worthless men opposite him..."

questions.question: What letters did Jezebel write?
options: Letters in Ahab's name, sealed with his seal, to the elders and leaders
questions.correctAnswer: Letters in Ahab's name, sealed with his seal, to the elders and leaders
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:8 (ESV): "So she wrote letters in Ahab's name and sealed them with his seal..."

questions.question: Where was Ahab when Elijah found him?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:18 (ESV): "...Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone to take possession."

questions.question: How did Ahab exhibit his mood when Naboth refused?
options: Vexed and sullen, lay on his bed, turned away his face, would eat no food
questions.correctAnswer: Vexed and sullen, lay on his bed, turned away his face, would eat no food
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:4 (ESV):And Ahab went into his house vexed and sullen... And he lay down on his bed and turned away his face and would eat no food."

key_verse_text: But Naboth said to Ahab, “The LORD forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers.” (ESV)
